newsitem.title: UK: Commercial Union up in pre-market trade.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Union up in pre-market trade.

text.p: Shares in Commercial Union Plc were marked higher in pre-market trading on Friday, against the trend of the rest of the market.
The stock was up 9-1/2p at 653-1/2 by 0817 GMT in volume of 150,000 shares.

Traders said there continued to be bid speculation around the insurance group. "There were a few buyers around last night at some fairly high prices," said one trader. Bid speculation "is always in the background," the trader said.
Press reports last weekend said B.A.T Industries Plc had been in talks with CU about a merger of its financial services operations with CU, but the talks had foundered.
Yet B.A.T responded by saying it was keeping an open mind about the possibility of a merger.
Speculation of mergers and takeovers in the insurance sector have swirled for much of the year, given added life by high-profile deals such as Royal Insurance's merger with Sun Alliance.
By the official start of trading at 0830 GMT, CU shares were up 13-1/2p at 657-1/2.
Elsewhere among insurance stocks, Legal & General, also seen as a possible bid target, was up 1/2p at 358-1/2 and Prudential Corp Plc was up 1p at 475-1/2.
Recent market speculation was that banking group Abbey National Plc could merge with the Pru.
